_comment: Component geometry read out of the S2 source in _import/. Values are code, not token data, so each entry names the file and symbol it came from. The conformance checker enforces the scales below.

controlHeight.note: Every interactive control (button, field, picker, menu item, chip, tab, action button) sits on this scale. 56 and 64 exist as component-height-400/500 for oversized surfaces.

smallControlSize.note: Checkbox box, radio dot, switch track height.

cornerRadius.note: Non-pill controls scale the 8px medium radius on a Major Second ladder (controlBorderRadius): XS 6, S 7, M 8, L 9, XL 10. Cards, popovers and toasts 10 (lg); dialogs and modals 16 (xl); checkbox 4 (sm).

fontSize.note: 14px is the UI default; 12px is the label/detail size; 11px is the smallest legal UI size.

fontWeight.note: Headings extra-bold (800), button labels bold (700), control labels medium (500), body regular (400).

borderWidth.note: 1px separators and field borders; 2px outline buttons, checkboxes, switches, focus ring.

motion.note: S2 1.6.0 moved the default transition to 150ms; earlier imports of this system recorded 130ms.

press.note: The press-down scale is an S2 signature; keep it on every pressable surface.

iconSize.note: 20px is the default; icons sit left of labels separated by text-to-visual-100 (6px).
